findings.detail: check_artifact_budget raises the failure message 'R476 artifact budget exceeded' with a hardcoded round label; if R477 trips the budget the message mislabels the round. Cosmetic only: the raise still blocks finalization fail-closed.

import_r476_training_shards verifies the R476 manifest fields (round, valid, 43200 steps, arm/seed, factors, reward-function and base-state hashes) and hardlink identity, but does not re-hash half.pt/final.pt/full_curves.npz against the R476 manifest's recorded checkpoint/curves hashes. A drifted artifact is caught later at evaluation load (eval shard fails -> EXECUTION-INCOMPLETE -> manifest refused), so no wrong scientific conclusion is reachable; an explicit re-hash at import would localize the failure to the import phase.
verify_formal_seal docstring still says 'Verify every R476 authority input' although the shared module now also serves R477; stale label, cosmetic only.
